svg.title: The Analytics Engine — from raw records to a financial report
svg.desc: Quick overview · follow 01 → 09 · internal engine, no endpoint of its own
svg.text: The Analytics Engine — from raw records to a financial report
Quick overview · follow 01 → 09 · internal engine, no endpoint of its own

g.text: 5 parallel Mongo reads build one context
6 deterministic modules — no model, no ML
6 calculators, weighted into one health score
One report object — cached and persisted
Every analyzer and score calculator is arithmetic over the user's own records — thresholds and formulas,
The ML Service and SIA are not called anywhere in this pipeline.

svg.text: The engine has no HTTP boundary of its own. It is invoked exactly two ways: a cache-miss read (REPORT-01) or a mutation-triggered refresh (FLOW-02).
